reviews.name: Soft Sparkles
reviews.reason: Contrast and Midnight Neon color cues improve over the legacy hash, but the rendered result is still a sparse dashed ring with flat star sprites and dots. It lacks volumetric particle depth, layered foreground/background sparkle, convincing emissive falloff and premium spatial richness even for Tier 1.

reviews.name: Cloud Puffs
reviews.reason: Candy palette and cloud identity are readable, but four repeated flat cloud shapes still read as icon art rather than an aura. Add true puff volume, depth staggering, translucent atmospheric overlap, softer cast/emissive light and a more spatial surrounding effect while keeping Tier 1 simple.

reviews.name: Pixel Bits
reviews.reason: The colored pixel blocks have better glow and some dimensional shading, but the effect remains a flat elliptical orbit around a generic star and Adventure Club is weakly expressed. Build more three-dimensional depth/parallax and a specific exploration/adventure signature without overloading the starter tier.

reviews.name: Berry Hearts
reviews.reason: Berry-heart and Cloud Pop cues are clear and card-readable, but the hearts/cloud remain flat sticker-like objects around a broad ring. Tier 2 still needs layered depth, soft volumetric cloud treatment, richer heart material and convincing surrounding glow/occlusion.

reviews.name: Berry Bunny
reviews.reason: Fresh pixels fix the legacy flat-mascot defect: the bunny has rounded toy/plush anatomy, strong ear/body depth, believable surface highlights and shadows, clear berry/strawberry identity, child-friendly expression and clean card-scale silhouette. It is richly finished but still simple enough for Tier 1.

reviews.name: Sunny Bird
reviews.reason: The replacement is convincingly dimensional with rounded body volume, layered feather forms, cast/contact shadow, warm directional sun lighting and an unmistakable garden/sun identity. It reads cleanly at card scale and provides a credible Tier-2 step above the simpler starter companion.

reviews.name: Pixel Bot
reviews.reason: The legacy flat robot problem is resolved: this version has distinct molded toy-robot anatomy, joints, beveled panels, glossy/plastic material separation, a dark pixel-face display and strong teal/magenta neon illumination. Tier 4 spectacle is materially richer without harming card readability.

reviews.name: Dream Dragon
reviews.reason: The replacement has strong three-quarter dragon anatomy, dimensional limbs/head/horns, translucent iridescent wings, soft candy/pastel materials, controlled glow and a clear premium Tier-4 silhouette. It is visually distinct from the other accepted companions and fixes the legacy flat-vector failure.
